testo:
■ The attached creature gets "powered breaker". (A creatures that has "powered breaker" break an additional shield for each 6000 power.)
■ When you attach this to a creature, look at the top card of your deck or super gacharange zone. You may put it on the bottom of your deck or super gacharange zone.
Orega Aura
